jobs.title: Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – Information Technology (IT)
jobs.description:
About Resillion

Resillion is a global provider of digital assurance, cybersecurity, and testing services. We help organisations strengthen their security posture, protect critical assets, and deliver high-quality digital solutions. Our teams operate across multiple specialist disciplines, including Digital Forensics, Incident Response, SOC Operations, Quality & Compliance, and Technical Consultancy. We are committed to excellence, continuous improvement, and delivering trusted, customer-focused services that meet the highest professional and accreditation standards.

Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – Information Technology (IT)

Location:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
Salary:
Dependant on level of experience
Job Type:
Full-time, Permanent (Hybrid) – 3 days a week in the Amsterdam Office with occasional travel to the Hasselt Office in Belgium

This role would be suitable for an established IT Agency Recruiter looking to move to an In-House role/

** PLEASE NOTE – WE CAN ONLY ACCEPT APPLICANTS WHO ARE HIGHTLY FLUENT IN BOTH DUTCH AND ENGLISH AND HAVE PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE RECRUITING INTO BELGIUM, THE NETHERLANDS AND GERMANY **

Help Shape the Future of Technology Talent

We're looking for a passionate Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – IT
to join our collaborative Global People team.
This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in attracting and hiring the talented professionals across Belgium, The Netherlands and Germany
who help deliver innovative software testing, quality assurance, and cyber security solutions to clients across the BeNeDE region and beyond.
This role will be the sole Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – IT
for the region but working closely with other Talent Acquisition professionals in both the UK and India, you'll partner with hiring managers across the business, influence recruitment strategy, and create outstanding candidate experiences while helping us scale our growing organisation.

What You'll Be Doing

As a trusted Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – IT
, you'll own the full recruitment lifecycle for a wide range of technical positions, including permanent and contractor hires with a strong focus on Direct Sourcing.

Build strong partnerships with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring needs and workforce plans.
Manage end-to-end recruitment from vacancy briefing through to offer and onboarding.
Direct Source high-quality IT professionals using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, referrals, talent mapping, and proactive direct sourcing search techniques.
Develop and maintain talent pipelines for future hiring requirements.
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout every stage of the recruitment process.
Advise stakeholders on recruitment best practice, market trends, salary benchmarking, and hiring strategies.
Support contractor recruitment while ensuring compliance with IR35 and relevant UK employment legislation.
Champion diversity, equity and inclusion by embedding inclusive recruitment practices into every campaign.
Create engaging recruitment marketing content for LinkedIn and other social media platforms.
Use recruitment data and metrics to continuously improve hiring outcomes.

What We're Looking For

You'll be an experienced recruiter who enjoys working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and takes pride in finding exceptional technology talent.

You will bring:

Proven experience recruiting within the IT or Technology sector.
Experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle across permanent and contractor hiring.
Strong direct sourcing skills with confidence using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools to avoid any agency reliance
Experience recruiting IT Software Testing, QA, Cyber Security or Digital professionals would be highly desirable
Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
Knowledge of right-to-work legislation, and current recruitment best practice.
Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
A proactive approach to talent pipelining and workforce planning.
Experience creating engaging recruitment campaigns across social media.
A genuine passion for delivering an outstanding candidate experience.
Previous experience within an in-house Talent Acquisition or RPO environment would be advantageous.
Experience recruiting Software Testing, QA, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, or Digital professionals would be highly desirable.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you'll be recognised for:

Building trusted relationships with hiring managers.
Delivering high-quality hires through direct sourcing.
Developing strong talent pipelines for future growth.
Improving time-to-hire and quality-of-hire metrics.
Driving diversity and inclusion across recruitment activities.
Providing an exceptional recruitment experience for candidates and stakeholders alike.

Why Join Us?

This is more than a recruitment role—it's an opportunity to influence how we attract, engage, and hire the talented people who will shape our future.
You'll join a supportive, collaborative team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is trusted, and you'll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact while developing your career in Talent Acquisition.

jobs.title: Director, HR Business Partner, International
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases. We develop medicines for previously untreatable or undertreated diseases. We recognize the courage it takes for patients and their caregivers to begin their journey of advocacy to find the answers they need. Their courage inspires us to challenge convention, ask bold questions and seek answers for them. Every day, we strive for excellence through our willingness to adapt, learn, and our tenacity to overcome barriers, together.

Opportunity Overview

Rhythm Pharmaceuticals is seeking an experienced and collaborative Director, Human Resources Business Partner to support employees and leaders across our Italian, Spanish, International Marketing, International Market Access and International Medical teams. As the primary HR partner for these teams, this role will provide both tactical guidance and hands-on support across the employee lifecycle.

As a key member of the International HR team, the successful candidate will work closely with the Executive Director, International HR Business Partner to develop and execute people strategies that support business growth while aligning with global priorities and local market needs.

This role is ideal for an HR leader with experience in small to mid-sized pharmaceutical or biotechnology organizations who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building solutions, and is equally comfortable shaping strategy and rolling up their sleeves to support managers and employees directly.

Responsibilities & Duties

Serve as the primary HR partner for employees and leaders across our Italian, Spanish, International Marketing, International Market Access and International Medical teams, providing guidance and hands-on support across the employee lifecycle.
Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, talent management, employee engagement, change management, and leadership development, helping to build high-performing and inclusive teams.
Provide guidance on employee relations, performance management, investigations, disciplinary processes, and other workplace matters, while supporting the administration of talent processes including objective setting, employee development, and succession planning.
Partner with hiring managers to identify talent needs, support recruitment for key commercial and medical roles, and ensure a positive candidate and onboarding experience.
Support the execution of regional HR programs and initiatives, including learning and development, talent reviews, organizational development, and employee engagement activities.
Ensure compliance with employment laws and labor practices across their client groups, partnering with internal stakeholders and external counsel on employment law, policy, compliance, and risk management matters.
Provide operational support for international benefit programs, including plan administration, employee guidance and communications, vendor interactions, and renewal and implementation activities across multiple countries.
Support the development and implementation of HR policies, processes, and best practices that balance business and compliance needs.
Collaborate closely with payroll, the broader HR team, and the Executive Director, International HR Business Partner to deliver a consistent employee experience and execute regional people strategies that support continued business growth.
Ensure all activities are conducted in strict accordance with applicable laws, regulations, industry standards, internal compliance requirements, and Rhythm policies, while upholding the highest standards of ethics, integrity and business conduct.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree and/or HR certification preferred.
10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant HR Business Partner experience supporting leaders and employees across multiple countries and/or functions.
Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or healthcare industry, preferably within a small to mid-sized, growing organization.
Strong knowledge of employment law, labor practices, benefits, and HR compliance requirements within one or more of the countries supported.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex employee relations matters and provide practical, business-focused guidance to leaders.
Experience supporting commercial, medical affairs, and/or corporate functions.
Strong business acumen, communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business strategy into effective people solutions.
Proven ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Collaborative, pragmatic, and solution-oriented approach, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and support the business directly.
Ability to identify opportunities, manage complexity and priorities and liaise, influence internally to ‘make it happen’ whilst being comfortable working with uncertainty
Not accepting the status quo, working with a sense of urgency to deliver results
Self-starter mentality who feels comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly desirable

More about Rhythm

At Rhythm our core values are:

We are committed to advancing scientific understanding to improve patients’ lives
We are inspired to tackle tough challenges and have the courage to ask bold questions
We are eager to learn and adapt
We believe collaboration and ownership are foundational for our success
We value the unique contribution each individual brings to furthering our mission

Inherent in our core values is the commitment to act ethically and with integrity in all we do.

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
Ever wondered what it's like to shape the employee experience at a company that's internationally scaling? At ComplianceWise, you won't just support HR, you'll own it, end to end.

We're a fast-growing SaaS scale-up building AML compliance technology that's redefining how organizations stay compliant. Our platform, Grub, helps over 600 organizations stay on the right side of Dutch financial crime regulations, and we're just getting started. We're based in Amsterdam and expanding across Europe.
We're open, international, and refreshingly non-hierarchical. Trust, collaboration, and a healthy dose of humour are baked into how we work, because we believe work should be challenging, rewarding, and genuinely enjoyable. Our values
: we succeed as a team, we make things happen, we launch and learn, and we embrace honesty

+ About the role

People are at the heart of how we build this company, and we're looking for someone who actually believes that. As our People Business Partner, you'll operationally own the full employee experience, from the moment someone says yes to the offer, to the day they leave. You are the person employees feel comfortable coming to before things become a bigger deal. You will work closely with the leadership and report to the COO.

+ What you’ll do

Recruitment & onboarding

Own the full hiring process from job posting to offer to first day
Build our employer brand and attract people who'll genuinely thrive here
Make sure new joiners feel set up for success, and that offboarding is handled with the same care

Talent & development

Run reviews, feedback cycles, and coaching conversations
Own our L&D program and help people grow in the right direction for them
Partner with managers on team dynamics and where their people want to grow

People ops & compliance

Manage payroll, benefits, compensation reviews, and HR tooling, keep the engine run smoothly
Handle documentation, contracts, and legal requirements, including as we expand internationally
Keep our HR systems and processes tidy and up to date

Culture & employee experience

Keep a real pulse on how people are feeling and turn that into action
Organize moments that bring the team together, not just events for the sake of it
Own other people moments: birthdays, anniversaries etc and the office experience
Support wellbeing and make sure people feel genuinely heard
Contribute to how we think about people as we grow

+ What you bring

HR experience, ideally across both recruitment and people operations, you're comfortable owning the process, not just supporting it.
Strong people instincts: genuine empathy, real discretion, and the ability to have honest conversations when they're needed
A proactive mindset: you notice things before they become problems and take ownership without being asked
Sharp organizational skills and solid follow-through: people can count on you to get things done
Comfort with a degree of ambiguity: you can pick up context quickly, figure out what matters most, and keep moving

+ What you get

Competitive salary
Growth opportunity to become the trusted strategic partner of the leadership team
25 vacation days, plus the option to take 2 additional weeks of unpaid leave per year
Hybrid working: up to 2 days per week from home, and up to 2 weeks per year working remotely abroad
Special leaves including D&I day off, volunteering day off, and moving day off.
Option to take a sabbatical upon reaching milestones.
OpenUp subscription for mental wellbeing
Public transport reimbursement
An organization that truly invests in your personal and professional development
Multiple ways to connect as a team, including team events, shared lunches, and optional Thursday drinks (DoMiBo)
We value flexibility, work-life balance, and family-friendly policies to help you thrive both professionally and personally.
A bright office in Amsterdam overlooking the Olympic Stadium

+ Inclusivity & Equal Opportunities

At ComplianceWise, we strive for an inclusive work environment where everyone feels welcome and valued. We encourage everyone to apply. Do you have a disability or need accommodations during the application process? Email us at recruiting@compliance-wise.com with your name, the role you are applying for, and your request. We are happy to help.

+ How to Apply

Excited about this role and think you’re a great fit? Apply by sending your CV to recruiting@compliance-wise.com . Note: You must be authorized to work within the EU for this role

jobs.title: HR Manager Benelux | People Operations
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global leader in virtual care, with over 100 million users and more than 500 million annual healthcare interactions. We offer the only comprehensive virtual care solution that encompasses telemedicine, mental health, wellbeing, specialist medical advice and platform services.

Our Amsterdam team is growing. We are strengthening and scaling our local People Operations to create a consistent, employee-focused HR foundation for our continued growth in the Netherlands.

Role:

A hands-on, high-execution role at the heart of our people’s function.

This position plays a key role in running day-to-day HR operations while contributing to Teladoc Health's people strategy in Amsterdam as we scale.

Teladoc Health is looking for a hands-on HR Manager to take ownership of People Operations in the Netherlands. In this broad and autonomous role, you will ensure that our HR operations, recruitment and employee processes run smoothly, while acting as a trusted people partner to the Country Manager and local Management Team.

You will be the primary HR contact for employees in the Netherlands and work closely with colleagues in our regional and global People & Culture organization. Your initial focus will be on operational excellence, Dutch employment-law compliance, recruitment and employee experience. As the local HR foundation develops, you will also contribute to workforce planning, organizational development and other strategic people priorities.

Responsibilities:

Own end-to-end HR operations: contracts, onboarding, offboarding, payroll coordination, benefits administration, and employee records
Act as the first point of contact for employees on all people-related questions, from day-one logistics to day-to-day issues
Advise the Country Manager and local Management Team on people, organization and employment matters.
Ensure full compliance with Dutch labor law and internal policies, keeping documentation and processes audit-ready
Manage recruitment end to end for open roles, from job description to offer, as the main person driving the process
Build and continuously improve onboarding so new joiners ramp up quickly and feel at home fast
Take full ownership of HR processes day to day, prioritizing operational excellence and consistent execution over ad-hoc fixes
Identify gaps in current HR processes and implement practical, scalable improvements
Maintain accurate HR systems, trackers, and reporting so leadership always has an up-to-date picture of the team
Translate global People policies into effective local practices and identify where adaptation to Dutch requirements is needed.
Contribute to strategic people topics as they arise, including workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and org design input, while keeping operational delivery as the day-to-day priority

About You!

Experience:

At least five years of broad HR experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for HR operations in the Netherlands.
Sound working knowledge of Dutch employment law and local HR practices.
Experience with employee relations, absence management, payroll coordination and end-to-end recruitment.
Experience in an international, fast-growing, startup or scale-up environment is an advantage.

Languages:

Professional fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Digital skills:

Strong digital proficiency, including experience with HRIS, payroll interfaces, reporting tools and Microsoft 365.

Soft skills:

Essential: high execution power, approachable and easy-going manners, pragmatism, clear communication, with strong judgement, ownership, discretion, the ability to set priorities independently, and eagerness to grow with the company

Education requirements:

Minimum studies: relevant degree or equivalent professional experience in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

Compensations & Benefits:

The gross monthly salary for this role ranges from EUR 5,750 to EUR 7,000 based on a 40-hour working week, excluding 8% holiday allowance. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s relevant experience and fit with the scope of the role. In addition, we offer pension contribution, travel allowance, Teladoc Academy and a hybrid working arrangement.

jobs.title: HR Manager EY-Parthenon
jobs.description:
Zeker van je impact vandaag. Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen.

Bij EY weet je zeker dat je het verschil maakt: voor je klant, de samenleving, je collega én je eigen ontwikkeling. Tegelijk krijg je de vrijheid om te werken op een manier die bij jouw leven past. Of je nu kiest voor verdieping, verbreding of leiderschap: jij hebt de regie. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s in een open en vertrouwde cultuur ga je elke dag voor het hoogst haalbare. Groot in mogelijkheden, vriendelijk in samenwerking. EY zorgt voor de middelen die je nodig hebt je carrière verder vorm te geven en impact te maken binnen jouw vakgebied.

Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Als HR Manager EY-Parthenon vervul je een uitdagende en veelzijdige HR -rol binnen één van de meest dynamische onderdelen van EY. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de HR-ondersteuning van EY-Parthenon, de strategie- en transactiepraktijk van EY, en werkt samen met leidinggevenden, partners en de Talent Leader aan het realiseren van onze ambitie: Let's empower people to become Exceptional You.
Door de combinatie van strategische vraagstukken, directe samenwerking met partners en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief is dit een uitstekende rol voor een HR-professional die impact wil maken binnen een snelgroeiende en ambitieuze organisatie.
Dit is een rol met veel verantwoordelijkheid, zichtbaarheid en ondernemerschap. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te opereren, HR-beleid te vertalen naar de praktijk en actief mee te denken over de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

In deze rol:
Ben je de sparringpartner voor business leaders en de Talent Leader op uiteenlopende HR-thema's, zoals performance management, workforce planning, talentontwikkeling, mobiliteit, verzuim, verloop en beloningsvraagstukken.
Adviseer je over zowel operationele als tactische HR-vraagstukken binnen een ambitieuze en snelgroeiende praktijk.
Speel je een belangrijke rol in de uitvoering van de volledige employee lifecycle, waaronder beoordelingsrondes, promoties, salarisvoorstellen, ontwikkelingstrajecten en mobiliteitsvraagstukken.
Begeleid je organisatieveranderingen en ondersteun je leidinggevenden bij complexe HR-cases en verandertrajecten.
Analyseer je HR-data en managementinformatie en vertaal je inzichten naar concrete acties en adviezen voor de business.
Draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten binnen EY en EY-Parthenon, gericht op het versterken van de employee experience en het realiseren van organisatiedoelstellingen.
Signaleer je kansen voor verbetering en neem je initiatief om HR-processen verder te optimaliseren.
Schakel je moeiteloos tussen dagelijkse HR-uitdagingen en strategische vraagstukken die bijdragen aan de verdere groei van EY-Parthenon.
Bouw je sterke relaties op met stakeholders binnen de business en werk je nauw samen met collega's uit het landelijke HR-team.

Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega's en het kantoor

Jouw team

Je maakt onderdeel uit van het HR-team van EY Nederland, maar werkt primair voor EY-Parthenon. EY-Parthenon ondersteunt organisaties bij hun meest complexe strategische vraagstukken op het gebied van groei, transformatie, transacties en waardecreatie. Door strategie, uitvoering en diepgaande sectorkennis te combineren, ondersteunt EY-Parthenon klanten bij het realiseren van duurzame groei en blijvende impact.
Wat deze functie bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van zelfstandigheid en samenwerking. Je bent dé HR-contactpersoon voor EY-Parthenon en hebt daardoor veel eigenaarschap en invloed op alles wat met HR binnen deze praktijk te maken heeft. Tegelijkertijd sta je er nooit alleen voor: je werkt nauw samen met ervaren HR-collega's binnen EY en kunt altijd sparren met de HR Business Partner en HR Talent Lead.
Daarnaast werk je in een omgeving waar de lijnen kort zijn en je direct schakelt met senior stakeholders. Hierdoor heb je niet alleen zicht op belangrijke besluitvorming, maar kun je ook daadwerkelijk invloed uitoefenen op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie en haar medewerkers.
EY-Parthenon kenmerkt zich door een ondernemende, intellectueel uitdagende en resultaatgerichte cultuur. Collega's dagen elkaar uit om het beste uit zichzelf te halen, terwijl samenwerking, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en collegialiteit centraal staan.

Jouw kantoor

Je standplaats is Amsterdam (Zuidas). Daarnaast ben je bereid maandelijks aanwezig te zijn op ons kantoor in Den Haag en incidenteel te reizen naar Rotterdam, Zwolle en Eindhoven.

Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van Human Resource Management, Bedrijfskunde, Psychologie of een vergelijkbare studie.
Minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, bij voorkeur binnen HR of HR-consulting.
Je kunt goed luisteren, beschikt over sterke adviesvaardigheden en bent communicatief sterk. Dit stelt je in staat om effectief te adviseren en duurzame relaties op te bouwen met uiteenlopende stakeholders.
Je hebt een proactieve klant- en resultaatgerichte houding en bent in staat effectieve werkrelaties op te bouwen binnen een internationale organisatie met een partnerstructuur.
Je bent analytisch sterk en pakt werkzaamheden zelfstandig, proactief en gestructureerd op. Hierdoor weet je prioriteiten te stellen en kwaliteit te leveren in een dynamische omgeving.
Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift.
Je beschikt over een agile mindset en bent flexibel en aanpasbaar in je manier van denken en handelen. Je staat open voor verandering, zoekt voortdurend naar verbetering en hecht waarde aan teamwork.
Je weet zelfstandig te functioneren in een dynamische, veeleisende omgeving, maar stelt ook tijdig de juiste vragen of escaleert wanneer nodig.
Klantgerichtheid en een stevige persoonlijkheid zijn belangrijke eigenschappen, gecombineerd met enthousiasme, energie en drive.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier

Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Boven op je salaris ontvang je vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling).
Je krijgt een contract voor 40 uur.
Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.
34 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken.
Met het mobiliteitsbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een leaseauto, een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app.
Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt.
De mogelijkheid om 20 werkdagen per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken.
De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen.
Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.
Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing.
Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk.

En dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik hier
